parameters.toolDescription: Ambil KPI harian merchant: total order, order terkirim, order batal/gagal, cancel rate %, order tepat waktu, dan SLA 30 menit %.
parameters.query:
WITH ref_date AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $fromAI("date", "Tanggal order format YYYY-MM-DD. Kosongkan untuk hari data terakhir", "string") }}', ''), (SELECT hari_data_terakhir::text FROM core.data_info))::date AS dt
),
ord AS (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM core.orders o, ref_date
  WHERE o.merchant_id = '{{ $fromAI("merchant_id", "ID merchant, contoh: M001 sampai M012", "string") }}'
    AND o.order_date = ref_date.dt
),
deliv AS (
  SELECT
    count(*)::int AS total_delivered,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.actual_minutes <= d.promised_minutes)::int AS on_time
  FROM core.deliveries d
  JOIN ord o USING (order_id)
  WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT
  '{{ $fromAI("merchant_id", "ID merchant, contoh: M001 sampai M012", "string") }}' AS merchant_id,
  (SELECT dt FROM ref_date) AS tanggal,
  count(ord.*)::int AS total_order,
  count(ord.*) FILTER (WHERE ord.status = 'delivered')::int AS order_terkirim,
  count(ord.*) FILTER (WHERE ord.status IN ('cancelled', 'failed'))::int AS order_batal_gagal,
  ROUND(COALESCE(count(ord.*) FILTER (WHERE ord.status IN ('cancelled', 'failed'))::numeric / NULLIF(count(ord.*), 0)::numeric * 100, 0), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct,
  COALESCE((SELECT on_time FROM deliv), 0) AS terkirim_tepat_waktu_30m,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT on_time::numeric FROM deliv) / NULLIF((SELECT total_delivered FROM deliv), 0)::numeric * 100, 0), 2) AS sla_30m_pct
FROM ord;

parameters.toolDescription: Ambil rincian alasan pembatalan/kegagalan order merchant dan contoh catatan pelanggan (data tidak tepercaya).
parameters.query:
WITH ref_date AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $fromAI("date", "Tanggal order format YYYY-MM-DD. Kosongkan untuk hari data terakhir", "string") }}', ''), (SELECT hari_data_terakhir::text FROM core.data_info))::date AS dt
),
reasons AS (
  SELECT
    cancel_reason,
    count(*)::int AS jumlah
  FROM core.orders, ref_date
  WHERE merchant_id = '{{ $fromAI("merchant_id", "ID merchant, contoh: M001 sampai M012", "string") }}'
    AND order_date = ref_date.dt
    AND status IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
  GROUP BY cancel_reason
),
notes AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    cancel_reason,
    customer_note
  FROM core.orders, ref_date
  WHERE merchant_id = '{{ $fromAI("merchant_id", "ID merchant, contoh: M001 sampai M012", "string") }}'
    AND order_date = ref_date.dt
    AND status IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
    AND customer_note IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY order_id
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  '{{ $fromAI("merchant_id", "ID merchant, contoh: M001 sampai M012", "string") }}' AS merchant_id,
  (SELECT dt FROM ref_date) AS tanggal,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('alasan', cancel_reason, 'jumlah', jumlah)) FROM reasons), '[]'::json) AS ringkasan_alasan,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('order_id', order_id, 'alasan', cancel_reason, 'catatan_pelanggan_untrusted', customer_note)) FROM notes), '[]'::json) AS contoh_catatan_pelanggan;

parameters.toolDescription: Cek ketersediaan stok produk per merchant dan/atau per SKU produk.
parameters.query:
SELECT
  s.merchant_id,
  p.sku,
  p.name AS product_name,
  p.category,
  s.qty,
  s.synced_at,
  CASE
    WHEN s.qty = 0 THEN 'habis'
    WHEN s.qty <= 5 THEN 'menipis'
    ELSE 'cukup'
  END AS status_stok
FROM core.merchant_stock s
JOIN core.products p USING (product_id)
WHERE s.merchant_id = '{{ $fromAI("merchant_id", "ID merchant, contoh: M001 sampai M012", "string") }}'
  AND (
    '{{ $fromAI("sku", "SKU produk spesifik (contoh: SKU-001). Kosongkan untuk melihat semua stok merchant", "string") }}' = ''
    OR p.sku = UPPER('{{ $fromAI("sku", "SKU produk spesifik (contoh: SKU-001). Kosongkan untuk melihat semua stok merchant", "string") }}')
  )
ORDER BY s.qty ASC, p.sku ASC;
